name: trellis_workspace_describe
description: Index status and limits. Per language, `coverage` counts native syntax tuples and `semantic` reports the selected imported producer (for example rust-analyzer or scip-typescript SCIP): `available` is true when it is fresh and covers documents, with its own tuple counts, so partial coverage of either stays visible. Call this first. Pass `coverageDocuments:{}` (optional `language`, `limit` 1-50, default 20, `offset`) to page the failed and partial semantic documents with reason codes. `apps` lists the detected and authored apps (name, source, kind, manifest, roots, entries, languages, fileCount) once the head's architecture is computed; pass one's name or manifest as `app` to filter other tools.

name: trellis_find_symbols
description: Find declarations by literal name or ID substring (no regex), callables and types first. Returns symbol IDs and stable lookup keys for the other tools, with line ranges. `scopeCoverage` reports the returned languages' semantic evidence; `syntaxOnly` names those without it. `compact:true` drops documents, coverage and provenance. `app` keeps declarations in that app's files, from the first 500 ranked names.

query.description: 1–1024 UTF-8 bytes; no trimming or normalization.

name: trellis_search_symbols
description: Rank declarations for a natural-language or code query (lexical plus local vector search when available). Returns symbol IDs and stable lookup keys for the other tools. Relevance is not proof; `scopeCoverage` reports the returned languages' semantic evidence. `compact:true` drops documents, coverage and provenance. `app` keeps hits in that app's files.

name: trellis_declaration
description: Read one declaration's measured record (signature header, ancestors, range and lines) by symbol ID. No body; use trellis_read_source with the returned lines.

includeExternal.description: Keep calls whose binding is external. Defaults to true, or false with compact:true.

name: trellis_outgoing_calls
description: List the calls made inside one declaration, with semantic bindings and targets where a fresh imported producer covers the language, else syntax-only name hints. Default limit 6 (max 50). Each distinct semantic basis appears once in `semanticBases`, referenced by `semanticBasisRef` and provenance `basisRef`; `compact:true` omits bindings, coverage and provenance for a much smaller answer. With `compact:true`, calls bound to external symbols are left out and counted in `externalOmitted` unless `includeExternal:true`.

name: trellis_incoming_calls
description: Find call sites whose callee name matches one declaration (name match, not proof), each annotated with its semantic binding where one is selected. Callers whose fresh direct binding targets another same-name declaration are left out and counted in `boundElsewhereOmitted`. Default limit 6 (max 50); production callers first. Each distinct semantic basis appears once in `semanticBases`; `compact:true` omits bindings, coverage and provenance, so 50 callers fit easily.

name: trellis_read_source
description: Read up to 200 lines (16 KiB) of indexed source by path and 1-based inclusive line range, from the cached snapshot, never the live disk.

name: trellis_call_graph
description: Build a bounded rooted call graph from one declaration, expanding only fresh exact semantic bindings. Defaults: depth 2, maxNodes 8, maxCalls 10 with full proofs; `compact:true` keeps node and stable lookup keys, names, paths, edge kinds and resolutions, drops bindings, coverage and provenance, and defaults to maxNodes 50, maxCalls 60. Each distinct semantic basis appears once in `semanticBases`; `responseOmitted` counts nodes and edges cut to fit the response. Without imported evidence every edge stops at the root; use trellis_outgoing_calls instead. Unexpanded calls whose callee is named like a project declaration rank before other names (`Some`, `clone`); `omitted.callLimit` counts the cut. `app` stops at calls into declarations outside that app (`omitted.filtered`, hint `app`).

name: trellis_references
description: Read pinned native-module and external-package references: structural syntax sites, plus fresh semantic call and type bindings where a producer is selected. Production and test sites are separate. Results page at about 24 KiB: repeat the call with `offset: page.nextOffset` until it is null. `groupBy:"directory"` (optional `depth`) or `"package"` (by app manifest, `noApp` outside every app) instead pages `groups` rows of summed sites per source and target group, largest first; `limit` then caps rows per page. `prefix` keeps only sources under a directory, and `depth` counts segments below it. `app` keeps only sources in that app.

limit.description: Rule instances per page (instances and testOnly together); each keeps one evidence entry (use trellis_rules_explain for more).

status.description: List only instances with these statuses, for example ["deviates"]. Counts stay those of the whole check.

name: trellis_rules_check
description: Check reviewed architecture rules against pinned evidence without writing files. Call/type constraints use fresh semantic bindings where available; otherwise they remain unknown. `limit` (default 20, max 50) counts rule instances per page, each with one evidence entry (trellis_rules_explain shows up to 50); `status`, for example ["deviates"], lists only those instances while counts stay whole. Each distinct semantic basis appears once per page in `semanticBases`. Results page at about 24 KiB: repeat the call with `offset: page.nextOffset` until it is null. `app` lists only the instances counted under that app, and its unassigned files; counts stay whole.

limit.description: Evidence entries kept per rule instance; omittedEvidence counts the rest.

name: trellis_rules_explain
description: Explain one exact architecture rule instance at a pin, including unknowns and reviewed exceptions. `limit` (default 5, max 50) is the evidence entries kept per instance. Each distinct semantic basis appears once per page in `semanticBases`. Results page at about 24 KiB: repeat the call with `offset: page.nextOffset` until it is null.

Show the user one Sequence (a function or method), Class diagram (a class, or a method's class) or source line (path and 1-based line) in every open Trellis viewer of this checkout that is not pinned. The target is checked against the current index first. Changes only what viewers display; outcome shown, no_viewer, not_found, stale or invalid.
name: trellis_show

description: List the HTTP endpoints between apps from pinned structural evidence: each server route (method, path template, handler, app) with the client call sites matched to it (confidence exact, template or wrapperInferred; caller; app), routes no call reached (`serverOnly`) and calls that reached no route (`clientOnly`). Name and path matches, never proof: a missing row proves nothing. `app` keeps rows with either end in that app. `method` and `pathTemplate` select one endpoint, with up to 50 call sites per row (5 otherwise; `callSiteCount` counts all). `limit` (default 20, max 50) counts rows per page: repeat with `offset: page.nextOffset` until it is null.
name: trellis_endpoints
